verdict.rationale: Hightouch's docs say syncs can run on a recurring schedule or a trigger, and that each run reports its outcome. This is direct support for recurring scheduled jobs, but the evidence only names the capability and does not describe how schedules are configured. The pack also never shows schedule configuration through the MCP server or the API, and recurring scheduling of journeys or workflows is only implied by 'automated journeys'. Missing for 10: documented schedule configuration options (intervals/cron), evidence of setting schedules via API or MCP for AI-native use, explicit recurring scheduling of journeys/workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: A sync runs on the schedule or trigger you set, then reports the outcome of each run so you can confirm it worked.
Sync to 300\+ destinations in real-time or on a recurring schedule.
Sync modeled data to sales, support, analytics, and internal tools on a schedule or when data changes.
A sync sends the rows a model returns to a destination, and defines how and when that data lands.
